promptTemplate: EDIT the supplied existing character into ONE production animation sprite sheet. Preserve the same individual: exact species, face, colours, eye shape, outfit/markings, accessories, silhouette language and painted chibi illustration style. Match the reference viewing angle; never turn the camera. ONE square canvas with EXACTLY4 columns and4 rows of equal square cells (16 separate full-body poses). True transparent background. No text, no labels, no visible grid, no shadows, no terrain/platform/pedestal, no detached particles. Every complete character fits within the central80% of its cell with generous transparent gutter on all four sides. Keep the same head size, body scale and centered torso anchor across all16 cells. Never crop ears, tail, wings, feet or accessories. Row1 idle4 poses: resting neutral, breathing inhale, CLOSED-EYES blink, breathing exhale neutral. Row2 locomotion4 poses: {MOTION}. Row3 happy4 poses: anticipation crouch, joyful small hop, soft landing, settle smile. Row4 skill4 poses: anticipation, charging pose, casting gesture/open-mouth pose, recovery. {SKILL} Real different poses of legs/wings/neck/tail; do NOT just shift/rotate the identical drawing. Ensure sequential motion loops smoothly and every pose remains clearly the same pet. Clean isolated alpha edges. Target1024x1024 square atlas,256x256 cells.

phoenix.prompt: Create a production sprite animation atlas from the supplied phoenix character. This is an EDIT of the existing pet: preserve its exact cute orange/gold chibi phoenix identity, eye shape, face, feather style, outline thickness, palette, large flame tail, golden wings, and 3/4-facing-right viewing angle. Output ONE SQUARE PNG atlas with EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, edge-to-edge layout. No visible grid, no text, no labels, no ground, no background or shadows; true transparent alpha. Every cell contains exactly one complete phoenix at identical head size and aligned body center, plenty of transparent padding so even spread wings and tail fit in the cell. Do not crop any part. Camera and perspective stay fixed across all16 cells. Row1 idle4 frames: neutral relaxed wings, gentle inhale, eyes closed blink, exhale neutral. Row2 flight4 frames in a clear looping wing flap: wings high up, wings halfway down, wings strongly down, wings halfway up; wing feathers and their shapes MUST change pose, not just rotate the entire image. Feet tuck, flame tail follows flight. Row3 happy4 frames: crouch, cheerful small hop with wings raised, soft landing with wings spread, settle smile. Row4 skill4 frames: anticipation with wings drawn in, raised wing charging stance, open-beak casting with wings spread, recovered stance. The skill row has NO detached particles or flame projectile; the character itself changes pose. Keep all16 animals the same individual with unchanged design and scale. Cute polished hand-painted illustration matching the input, not pixel art, not3D. Target1024x1024 square, one cell256x256. Render actual different limb poses and clean stable animation registration.
